description: Test suite for managing permission schemes in Mattermost, including creation, retrieval, updating, and deletion of schemes, with focus on role management and license restrictions.

methods.name: TestCreateScheme
methods.description: Tests creation of permission schemes with valid and invalid data, including license restrictions and role creation.

methods.name: TestGetScheme
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a specific scheme by ID, including error handling and permission checks.

methods.name: TestGetSchemes
methods.description: Tests listing schemes with filtering by scope and permission restrictions.

methods.name: TestGetTeamsForScheme
methods.description: Tests retrieving teams associated with a scheme, including error cases.

methods.name: TestGetChannelsForScheme
methods.description: Tests retrieving channels associated with a scheme, including error cases.

methods.name: TestPatchScheme
methods.description: Tests updating scheme details with valid, partial, and invalid data, including permission and license restrictions.

methods.name: TestDeleteScheme
methods.description: Tests deletion of schemes, ensuring roles are marked deleted and schemes are disassociated from teams/channels.

methods.name: TestUpdateTeamSchemeWithTeamMembers
methods.description: Verifies cache invalidation when updating team schemes with members.
